title: PRED-TMR: prediction of transmembrane segments in proteins
description: Modern C++17 re-implementation of the PRED-TMR algorithm (Pasquier et al., 1999), a statistical method that predicts transmembrane segments in protein sequences using only sequence information. It refines a hydrophobicity analysis with the detection of favourable terminal (start/end) configurations of transmembrane regions. This release provides a validated C++17 kernel, a native command-line interface, doctest unit tests, a WebAssembly module with a static web portal, and CI workflows.
